[Ding, congratulations, host has activated the Insect Mother Simulator.] 
[Please proceed immediately to find offspring you can command.] 
[Small hint: Not every insect can be tamed by you. Choose carefully, as failure means death and restart.] 
Thus, Asher decided to try taming the monster beside him.
The next second, he was impaled clean through.
Asher: …Great. Next time, don’t simulate.
